_comment: Planned configuration for createResourceGroup1 (No-Live-Tenant). Run 'uip maestro flow node configure DTLLoadByDefaultTrueTest.flow createResourceGroup1 --detail "$(cat createResourceGroup1.detail.json)"' after filling in the placeholders.
connectionId: <PLACEHOLDER: run 'uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-azure --all-folders --output json' to get connection Id>
folderKey: <PLACEHOLDER: use FolderKey from the same connections list output>

pathParameters.resourceGroupName: <PLACEHOLDER: desired resource group name, e.g. my-rg-westeurope>

bodyParameters.location: <PLACEHOLDER: Azure region — run 'uip is resources run list uipath-microsoft-azure locations --connection-id <id> --output json' to pick from the location dropdown, e.g. eastus, westeurope, australiaeast>
